name: JM Forward Descendant Router v0.1
purpose: Route a truthfully closed FORWARD_READY JM keeper into a separately identified descendant Build Route Manifest without mutating the parent, bypassing Estate recovery, or authorizing implementation/new capability merely because forward creation is allowed.

rules.distinct_identity: The descendant body name must differ from the closed parent body name. A route is not a descendant merely because a version string was edited.
rules.parent_keeper: A parent keeper reference and 64-hex SHA-256 are mandatory. If the reference resolves to a file in the current checkout, the router must verify the actual file hash before routing.
rules.parent_immutability: The router never writes to or replaces the parent keeper. Once FREEZE has passed, all behavioural change proceeds through a separately routed descendant.
rules.recovery_pointer: The closure recovery pointer remains part of the descendant lineage record; forward routing does not replace it.
rules.inherit: INHERIT means continuity remains primarily within the parent's identity/role while a new versioned descendant carries the change.
rules.fork: FORK means a separately identified branch/body is intentionally created from the parent while preserving the parent as ancestor.
rules.radical_rethink: RADICAL_RETHINK requires FORK so a radical identity change cannot silently masquerade as an ordinary repair/version bump.
rules.reference_boundary: REFERENCE alone is not a descendant relation in this v0.1 router. A referenced body can be a donor without becoming the parent.
rules.intake_reentry: The router must emit the existing jm.build-route-manifest/0.1 prospective format through JM Build Intake rather than invent a parallel authorization format.
rules.fail_closed: A generated descendant route defaults build_authorized_by_manifest=false and new_capability_creation_authorized=false unless the normal Build Intake requirements are explicitly resolved.
rules.authorization_separation: FORWARD_READY means legitimate forward creation is no longer blocked. It is not build authorization, new-capability authorization, runtime proof, contact proof, or crown status.
rules.claim_boundary: The Forward Descendant Router proves lineage routing and re-entry into the existing build front door only. It does not create the descendant executable body.

recovered_laws: No restart: find the strongest existing body, repair it, continue from there.
Mesh does not mean merge; composition does not erase identity.
A handoff is the route through which difference gains legitimate control of continuity.
Frozen ancestors remain immutable; correct forward.
Estate -> creation, not creation -> eventually remembers Estate.
authority_boundary: The exact Donor Forge / Build DNA document was not independently recovered during this implementation pass, so this policy does not falsely cite it as direct authority. It relies on the recovered closure/handoff, restore-before-rebuild, lineage-preservation and current Build Intake authorities already present in the Estate.
